integrity: The universal result is proved analytically. A standalone exhaustive checker reconstructs Bell adjacency and all-pairs distances through \(n=6\) and compares them with an independently computed maximum-weight block matching. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the edgeless underlying graph; arbitrary graph constraints can destroy the labeled-recoloring construction.
The maximum-matching transfer-distance formula for abstract set partitions is prior work and is not asserted as new.
A residual risk remains that an older reconfiguration source under different terminology already states the same isometry.
title: Exact metric and diameter of Bell colour graphs of edgeless graphs
